name: Server Console
summary: A dashboard for your Automaton server: CPU, memory, disk, OS updates, restart status, versions, certificates and backups, with 24 hours of history and email and webhook warnings.
description: Shows how your Automaton server and its Runners are doing, read-only: CPU, memory, disk and load with 24 hours of history, Docker disk use, OS name and uptime, pending and security updates, restart required, server and Runner versions and whether a newer release exists, certificate expiry and the last backup. Sends one warning, by email through the server's SMTP and by webhook, when disk space runs low, security updates wait too long or a restart is overdue, and one message when it is resolved. It asks for server:read and notify:email, so it cannot change anything on the server.

application.description: A dashboard for your Automaton server: CPU, memory, disk, OS updates, restart status, versions, certificates and backups, with 24 hours of history and email and webhook warnings.

arguments: python -m py_compile main.py console.py && mkdir -p dist/ui && cp main.py console.py index.html dashboard.js dist/ && cp ui/app.css ui/app.js dist/ui/

settings.name: API_BASE_URL
settings.description: Base URL of this Automaton server's API, for example https://api.example.com

settings.name: EMAIL_TO
settings.description: Who gets warning emails through the server's SMTP: administrators, owner, project or off

settings.name: DISK_FREE_WARN_PERCENT
settings.description: Warn when less than this percent of the disk is free

settings.name: SECURITY_UPDATE_DAYS
settings.description: Warn when security updates have been waiting longer than this many days

settings.name: REBOOT_DAYS
settings.description: Warn when a restart has been required longer than this many days

secrets.name: WEBHOOK_URL
secrets.description: Where warnings are sent: a Slack, Discord or Telegram webhook URL, or any URL that accepts a JSON POST. Optional, in addition to the email. Empty: no webhook
